methods.description: Define (or redefine) a theme: its token overrides for light and dark; yields the theme
methods.long_description:
THEME-3: the authoring path is a ticket's ` ```theme name
[extends=parent] ` block (`tickets.create` / `amend` / `update`
register it, owned by that ticket); `define` stays for admin and
tests — an ownerless theme, refused for a name a block owns.

Defines the theme `name` — its token overrides for `light` and for
`dark`, each a map from a token (`--accent`, or `accent`) to its
value, replacing whatever it overrode before (THEME-8: a theme is a
name and a map over today's tokens; `default` overrides nothing and
cannot be defined). A token not in the contract, or a value that
could escape its declaration, is refused, naming each; nothing is
kept. Yields exactly one event: `theme`, as kept — or an in-band
`error`. `watch` carries it too. Under login: an editor on `*`.
methods.name: define

Takeover.description: Whether a level takes the themes from above (any case; true/yes, false/no too)

ThemeName.description:
THEME-8: a theme's name — lower case letters, digits and `-`,
starting with a letter, at most 40 (`ocean`): [`crate::themes::name_of`].

ThemeReach.description: How far a theme's adoption reaches (any case)

ThemeScope.description:
THEME-4: where a theme is adopted — `site`, or a shortcode by any
name [`ShortcodeRef`] takes.

TicketRef.description:
A ticket as a call names it (ORG-3): its key (`MNG-1`, a namesake's
`THEME.62-3`), any short form of its address (`MENGER/THEME-3`,
`hypermemetic:THEME-3`) or a path address (`PLEXUS/_MENGER/board`),
its codes folded to upper case — `mng-1` is `MNG-1`. The store
resolves it to the one ticket it names in the caller's reach.

TokenValue.description:
THEME-8: what a theme sets a token to (`#00796b`) — not blank, at
most 200 bytes, nothing that could end its declaration:
[`crate::themes::value_ok`].

dark.description: Token overrides in dark (optional; a face set for light holds in dark too)

name.description: The theme's name: lowercase letters, digits and -, e.g. ocean

Levels.description:
Everything the levels say for one ticket, the reader aside — what
[`resolve`] decides from.

frame.description: What it says of its frame alone.

shortcode.description:
The nearest shortcode that says anything — the ticket's own, else
the nearest hosting it (THEME-4) — and what it says.

ticket.description: What the ticket's frontmatter says of its view.

Regions.description: Who wears what: the site, the ticket view, the frame.

theme.description: The theme it adopts, if any.

Takeover.description: Whether a level takes the themes from above (any case; true/yes, false/no too)

Theme.description:
A theme as the server keeps it: its name and its overrides, by token
name (`--accent`), for light and for dark — what it says itself; the
rest comes from the theme it `extends` ([`flatten`]). THEME-3: a theme
is a ticket's ` ```theme ` block ([`crate::theme_block`]), owned as a
component is (COMP-3's rules).

extends.description: THEME-3: the theme it states its differences from (`None`: `default`).

imports.description: THEME-3: the https stylesheets it imports (a font's).

orphan.description:
THEME-3: its block is gone from its owner's body; it is kept,
read-only, while something uses it (a setting, a ticket's
frontmatter, a live theme extending it), and a block naming it adopts it.

owner.description:
THEME-3: the ticket whose body's block defines it — `None` for one
`themes.define` made, or an orphan.

rules.description: THEME-3: its `@font-face` and `m-*::part(…)` rules, as validated.

updated_unix.description: When it was last defined, unix seconds (0 for `default`).

ThemeLevel.description: The level a region's theme came from.

ThemeReach.description: How far a theme's adoption reaches (any case)

ThemeSetting.description: What the site or a shortcode says, as `themes.set` keeps it.

WatchEnd.description:
ACCESS-12: why an open watch ended — its caller verified again when the
grants moved (or its sign-in ended), and refused. Every watch (`tickets`,
`comments`, `themes`, `deployments`) ends with one `watch_closed { reason,
message }` and nothing after it.

oneOf.description:
Its grants changed: it holds the watch's grant nowhere any more, or
what it holds reaches nothing.
Verified again, it was refused for another reason (named in `message`).

Worn.description: What a region wears, and the level it came from.

from.description: The shortcode, for a shortcode's theme.

returns.description:
What the `themes` activation streams. Every method returns
`impl Stream<Item = ThemesEvent>`; a refusal is the in-band `Error`.

oneOf.description: A theme, as it is now (`define`, `get`, `list`).

THEME-3 (`watch`): a theme defined, its block written or amended,
orphaned or adopted — as it is now.

THEME-3 (`watch`): a theme left the registry — an orphan nothing
uses any more.

`theme_for`'s answer: each region's theme and the level it came
from, and what every level said.

ACCESS-12 (`watch`): the watch ended — its caller, verified again
when the grants moved or its sign-in ended, was refused. Last.
In-band refusal, naming the problem; nothing was written.
